text: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
nse_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has secured a significant order from Noida Metro Rail Corporation Ltd for the design and construction of the Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension Project. The Heavy Civil Infrastructure business vertical will handle part design and construction of a 15.1 km elevated viaduct extending from Botanical Garden to Noida Sector-142, and from Depot Station to Boraki. The scope includes building 10 elevated metro stations with architectural finishes. The project is scheduled for completion within 36 months. The order is classified as significant, indicating a value between 1,000 to 2,500 crore rupees. This announcement was issued on November 9, 2026.
